title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Potia, Province of Ifugao, into Lista and Confirming the Barangay of Sta. Maria, Municipality of Lista, Province of Ifugao, as the Seat of the Government of the Municipality of Lista

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6687_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Municipality of Potia is hereby changed to the Municipality of Lista.
The present seat of the municipal government in the Barangay of Sta. Maria, Municipality of Lista, Province of Ifugao is hereby confirmed as the seat of the government of the Municipality of Lista.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval and its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
